title: Predicate Migration: Optimizing Queries with Expensive Predicates
evidence_note: Models nonzero predicate cost and selectivity; plan placement changes produced orders-of-magnitude gains in POSTGRES.

title: Query Optimization in the Presence of Foreign Functions
evidence_note: Uses declarative semantic rules and cost extensions to enrich the equivalent-query search space.

title: Optimizing Disjunctive Queries with Expensive Predicates
evidence_note: Bypass plans skip costly disjunctive terms when cheaper terms determine the result.

title: Optimization Techniques for Queries with Expensive Methods
evidence_note: Defines a cost framework incorporating selection cost and selectivity and evaluates plan placement in Illustra.

title: Optimization of Queries with User-Defined Predicates
evidence_note: Extends optimization search to place user-defined predicates using cost and selectivity.

title: Cost Estimation of User-Defined Methods in Object-Relational Database Systems
evidence_note: Builds multidimensional histograms from sampled method executions to predict cost from inputs; DOI is issue-level.

title: Self-Tuning Cost Modeling of User-Defined Functions in an Object-Relational DBMS
evidence_note: Incrementally maintains UDF cost models from recent executions instead of requiring static pretraining.

title: Exploiting Correlations for Expensive Predicate Evaluation
evidence_note: Uses available, noisy, or absent selection probabilities to save UDF evaluations under accuracy constraints.

title: Dynamically Optimizing Queries over Large Scale Data Platforms
evidence_note: Pilot runs collect selectivity; execution statistics feed repeated cost-based join-order decisions.

title: MONSOON: Multi-Step Optimization and Execution of Queries with Partially Obscured Predicates
evidence_note: An MDP interleaves statistics collection, partial execution, and reoptimization when UDFs obscure statistics.

title: Opening the Black Boxes in Data Flow Optimization
evidence_note: Static code analysis extracts a handful of UDF properties sufficient for safe operator and join reordering.

title: Versatile Optimization of UDF-heavy Data Flows with Sofa
evidence_note: Uses a concise semantic property hierarchy and rewrite rules to optimize UDF-heavy dataflows.

title: Optimization of Complex Dataflows with User-Defined Functions
evidence_note: Surveys syntactic modification, semantic inference/annotations/code analysis, and UDF dataflow transformations.

title: The Many Faces of Data-centric Workflow Optimization: A Survey
evidence_note: Organizes data-centric workflow optimization dimensions and pre-execution techniques across arbitrary tasks.

title: Efficient Execution of User-Defined Functions in SQL Queries
evidence_note: Classifies translation to SQL/IR/in-engine integration and compares optimization, execution-model, and usability dimensions.

title: Froid: Optimization of Imperative Programs in a Relational Database
evidence_note: Transforms eligible imperative statements into relational expressions consumed by the ordinary SQL optimizer.

title: BlackMagic: Automatic Inlining of Scalar UDFs into SQL Queries with Froid
evidence_note: Demonstrates Froid and identifies it as SQL Server 2019 Scalar UDF Inlining.

title: The Key to Effective UDF Optimization: Before Inlining, First Perform Outlining
evidence_note: Deliberately partitions visible and opaque UDF regions; evaluates plan consequences on DuckDB and SQL Server.

title: Dear User-Defined Functions, Inlining isn't working out so great for us. Let's try batching to make our relationship work. Sincerely, SQL
evidence_note: Finds batching can beat inlining on complex UDFs and proposes a hybrid strategy.

title: An Architecture for Compiling UDF-centric Workflows
evidence_note: LLVM analysis extracts vectorizability and cost features; optimizer combines algebra, metadata, and UDF statistics for generated execution code.

title: Vectorized UDFs in Column-Stores
evidence_note: Exposes column batches to Python/NumPy UDFs to reduce invocation and conversion overhead.

title: YeSQL: You extend SQL with Rich and Highly Performant User-Defined Functions in Relational Databases
evidence_note: Combines tracing JIT, fusion, vectorization/parallelism, stateful UDFs, and relational-engine integration.

title: Optimizing UDF Queries in SQL Data Engines
evidence_note: Builds a DFG from a database plan, uses plan statistics in fusion optimization, and rewrites fused UDF/relational operators; repository lacks optimizer source.

title: The UDFBench Benchmark for General-purpose UDF Queries
evidence_note: Provides a real-world schema, 42 UDFs, 21 queries, five-engine implementation, datasets, scripts, and documented dimensions.

title: UDFBench: A Tool for Benchmarking UDF Queries on SQL Engines
evidence_note: Four-page tool demonstration for the same open UDFBench implementation.

title: Procedural Extensions of SQL: Understanding their usage in the wild
evidence_note: Derives an open, multi-dialect procedural benchmark from real production workload analysis.

title: GRACEFUL: A Learned Cost Estimator For UDFs
evidence_note: Joint UDF CFG/query-plan GNN predicts runtime and advises UDF/filter placement; local evidence verifies two-level support and third-level rejection.

title: Zero-Shot Cost Models for Out-of-the-box Learned Cost Prediction
evidence_note: Separates transferable plan structure from database-specific data characteristics for unseen-database cost prediction.

title: QURE: AI-Assisted and Automatically Verified UDF Inlining
evidence_note: LLMs propose SQL translations; a formal verifier establishes UDF/SQL equivalence and reports coverage and speedups.

title: A Framework For Inferring Properties of User-Defined Functions
evidence_note: Abstract-interpretation-based property inference; literature-only in the project and not an end-to-end reproduced optimizer integration.

title: Aggify: Lifting the Curse of Cursor Loops using Custom Aggregates
evidence_note: Direct UDF/stored-procedure loop transformation; peer-reviewed and materially extends loop-bearing relationalization coverage.

title: One WITH RECURSIVE is Worth Many GOTOs
evidence_note: Definitive peer-reviewed treatment of compiling arbitrary PL/SQL UDF control flow to recursive SQL; directly within transformation scope.

title: Extracting Equivalent SQL from Imperative Code in Database Applications
evidence_note: The subject is database-application imperative code rather than only server-side UDFs, but its algebraic extraction and SQL translation are directly relevant under the frozen transformation/representation criterion.

title: Tuplex: Data Science in Python at Native Code Speed
evidence_note: Explicitly compiles Python UDFs in data pipelines into an end-to-end native execution path and therefore satisfies the execution/IR criterion.

title: User-Defined Operators: Efficiently Integrating Custom Algorithms into Modern Databases
evidence_note: Directly integrates custom algorithms as algebraic operators in Umbra and PostgreSQL and is materially relevant to execution representation and optimizer integration.
